ai_content.intro: استمتع بمشاهدة مسلسل The Big Game (2020) مترجم بجودة عالية على توميتو.
ai_content.desc_ar: استمتع بمشاهدة مسلسل اللعبة الكبيرة مترجم بجودة عالية.
ai_content.desc_en: Sixteen contestants of a new survival show are taken to the Siberian taiga to compete for the price of one million euros. The rules are simple: no food, personal belongings, electricity, communications and civilization for hundreds of kilometers around. The one remains wins. Soon TV project turns into a deadly game, where LIFE becomes the main prize... What is it? Is it sick TV script? Who is behind this? And who can survive without losing their humanity?
